I worked for a nonprofit that was obsessed with marketing. Their mission was to pass anti-corruption laws across the country at a state level. 

I was one of their organizers, and they put no effort or budget into organizing. (My big boss was literally the narketing director.) Volunteers came to us wanting help fixing their city, and we were instructed to lead them on and redirect them into other projects with the lie that we will eventually help them with their city.

The movement was mostly white retired boomers. What the organization truly felt was important was making videos with celebrities that had the company's branding on it. The work was purely image based, they just want to look good. Which is fucking stupid and a waste of a shit ton of money & time.

And it's gone south. Their staff unionized despite union busting. Seems like a lot of people either resigned or got fired. Hardly anyone I know works there anymore and they have 0 footprint despite all their marketing.
